title: Reproduce: Identification of Associations with Dermatologic Diseases through a Focused GWAS of the UK Biobank.
primary_question: Can an autonomous clinical-research agent reproduce the source paper PMID 39624183 using its declared data sources: Neale Lab round-2 UK Biobank GWAS summary statistics and public functional annotation resources?
